import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(P)
    return (p[0]/P + p[1] + p[2]*P + p[3]*P**2 + p[4]*P**3 + p[5]*P*L + p[6]*P**2*L
            + t*(p[7]*P**2 + p[8]*P*L + p[9]*P**2*L))
